notes.title: Major Update !
Official Game Launch
notes.content:
Hello everyone, P. Wendler here!✌

I’m thrilled to announce the official launch of my game, set for December 2, 2024! After a lot of hard work and dedication, I’m excited to finally share this experience with you, filled with new content and enhancements.

Here’s what you can expect at launch:


 10 Playable Characters: Each with unique abilities, adding variety and new strategies to explore.
 60 Power-Ups Added: Boost your gameplay with a wide range of options that make the game even more dynamic.
 3 Challenging Bosses: Put your skills to the test with bosses featuring unique mechanics and tough challenges.
 5 New Enemies: Adding more variety and difficulty to each level.
 Improved Settings System: Quickly and easily adjust preferences for a more personalized experience.
 Camera Movement Enhancements: Experience smoother and more responsive camera movement for greater immersion.
 Controller Support: Play with a controller and dive into a new way to enjoy the game.


And this is just the beginning! I’ll be releasing free updates in the future to expand the content even further and keep improving the game.

Mark your calendars: December 2, 2024! Thank you so much to everyone who has supported the development so far. I can’t wait for you all to experience this adventure. See you at the launch!

Stay tuned for more updates on the game soon!🎉

Best regards,
Sunfish🐠

notes.title: Gamepad Support
notes.content:
Hello everyone, P. Wendler here!✌

I'm excited to announce that our game is on track for release this year! I'm thrilled to share that I managed to implement something I thought would be impossible: full controller support. The game was developed using an Xbox controller, but it should work just as well with a PlayStation controller. Below are the button configurations for each mode.

Gameplay Button Configuration

 Left Analog Stick: Moves the player
 A: Use/equip item
 Y: Discard item
 RB: Shoot
 RT: Dash
 D-pad Left/Right: Select item
 D-pad Down: Open inventory

Menu Button Configuration

 D-pad Up/Down: Navigate menu
 D-pad Left/Right: Change settings
 B: Return to the previous menu
 Start: Pause the game


For an enhanced gaming experience, using the controller activates auto-aim, which means the aiming cursor will not be visible when the controller is in use.

Stay tuned for more updates on the game soon!🎉

Best regards,
Sunfish🐠
